info.name: CRM - End-to-End API Workflow
info.description: Ordered, stateful workflow generated from every currently implemented backend API. Import CRM-Workflow.postman_environment.json and run the collection in saved order. It creates a unique organization, roles, invitation/member, lead configuration, team, lead lifecycle, reports, and a dummy marketplace account. Dummy marketplace credentials can create and queue connector work, but an external provider test may later fail as expected because no real IndiaMART key is used. API and local database flows otherwise use live IDs and tokens.
